title: Stale-leaderboard fabricated vacancy id still reachable via late ApiReturnedLeaderboard race (B1 still present since round 1)
evidence:
ApiReturnedLeaderboard(result) ->
      case result {
        Ok(response) -> #(
          Model(
            ..model,
            leaderboard: Success(response.entries),
            leaderboard_total: response.total,
            leaderboard_strong_count: response.strong_count,
            leaderboard_review_count: response.review_count,
            leaderboard_weak_count: response.weak_count,
            leaderboard_shortlisted_count: response.shortlisted_count,
            leaderboard_page: 1,
            leaderboard_loading_more: False,
          ),
          effect.none(),
        )
detail: ApiReturnedLeaderboard carries no vacancy id and never updates leaderboard_vacancy_id. On VacancyDetail(A) an in-flight refetch for A (UserConfirmedApproval line 2671, bulk-status line 4998) resolves after navigating to VacancyDetail(B) (tag already Some(B), line 5209-5210): Success(A entries) with tag Some(B) passes the route guard and resolves A's applications to B.
recommended_fix: Include vacancy_id in ApiReturnedLeaderboard (like ApiReturnedLeaderboardRefresh) and set leaderboard_vacancy_id from the response's own id, or discard the response when its id != current leaderboard_vacancy_id.

title: Demo click arm bypasses notification_target_path and drops vacancy-typed navigation
detail: Round-2 hard blocker class requires BOTH arms route through the pure notification_target_path/3. The demo arm inlines a partial copy: vacancy-typed clicks in demo hit `_, _ -> effect.none()` (no navigation, diverging from the real arm) and the routing decision is duplicated, so the helper's tests do not pin the demo path.
recommended_fix: In demo_update.gleam replace the inline case with client.notification_target_path(model, entity_type, entity_id) and modem.push on Some(path), mirroring the real arm exactly.

title: notification_target_path builds /vacancies/ path from unvalidated vacancy id
evidence:
case entity_type, entity_id {
    Some("vacancy"), Some(vid) -> Some("/vacancies/" <> vid)
detail: An empty-string entity_id (Some("vacancy"), Some("")) yields Some("/vacancies/") — a navigation to a non-route instead of the intended no-op. entity_id is server-supplied so the path is unlikely, but the function has no guard.
recommended_fix: Guard `vid == ""` (and aid in the application arm) to return None.
